cases.invariant: strict candidate-only proposal with linked source spans
no authority fields, duplicate keys, missing refs, cycles, reserved base
JavaScript slice offsets include Chinese, ASCII, full-width punctuation and emoji
UNIQUE, MULTIPLE, SELECTED and incomplete NOT_FOUND remain distinct
receipt, task, plan, hash and result pointer must be independently trusted
cases.mutation: wrong receipt, wrong pointer, negative incomplete

cases.invariant: same task, same FactKey, later revision only
predicate, entity, scenario, temporal scope, basis, unit, currency and completeness all match
VERIFIED requires satisfied requirements; SUCCEEDED requires every goal VERIFIED
cases.mutation: missing requirements, PARTIAL or CANCELLED goal

cases.invariant: FORBIDDEN rejects COMMAND; unknown argument sources and oversized state reject
revision increments exactly, terminal does not resurrect, existing scenario key cannot mutate
false, 0, [], null and omitted retain distinct semantics
recipe, template and part catalogue absence each require complete verified negative evidence
